project.name: Beta 2
project.title: Beta 2 · hand-set Hemistitch, watch size
project.blurb: Two Ø19 discs on Dual_Dial_Concept's dial centres, set by a crown at 3 o'clock between the swivel lugs. The crown's worm turns a small crown arbor, whose pinion drives the train: minute pinion 12 ← wheel 26, pinion 12 → wheel 32, pinion 13 → hour wheel 27 (exactly 12:1), so the discs keep true time against each other. 16 crown turns an hour. Module 0.6 (the 0.5 mm end mill has room in every tooth space), black delrin throughout, brass rods in 3 x 6 x 2.5 bearings showing like jewels. Movement 47.1 x 33.3 mm, 13.4 mm from the back of the plates to the top of the discs.
source: Claude, 2026-11-23, from Adam's brief: the watch version of Hemistitch, hand-set, standard movement layering with the guts on show, smallest envelope to a reliable machining tolerance, the case scaled to fit afterwards. Layout from a search over every rod, bearing flange, gear layer, the worm and the stem.

focus.label: Crown → E → first and second intermediate → discs
Crown works: stem, worm, E, stem bridge

rules.why: module 0.6: the 0.5 mm end mill has room in every tooth space

shop.note: black delrin throughout; fits are delrin placeholders until the press-fit test

arbors.name: Minute arbor
arbors.role: Turns once an hour; carries the minute disc. Its 12-tooth pinion is driven by the first intermediate wheel. Brass rod in two bearings (one in each plate).

arbors.name: First intermediate

partNames.a1: First intermediate wheel and pinion (one piece, 1/8" delrin)

arbors.role: Its wheel is driven by the crown (through E) and drives the minute pinion; its pinion drives the second intermediate. One piece of 1/8" delrin, milled from the pinion side.

arbors.name: Second intermediate

partNames.a2: Second intermediate wheel and pinion (one piece, 1/8" delrin)

arbors.role: 32:12 down from the first intermediate; its 13-tooth pinion drives the hour wheel 27:13. One piece of 1/8" delrin; the wheel has four arms (it shows between the discs).

arbors.name: Hour arbor
arbors.role: Turns once in 12 hours; the hour disc sits right on its wheel (riding high on the second intermediate pinion so the disc clears it).

arbors.name: Crown arbor (E)
arbors.role: Takes the crown: the worm on the stem turns its 16-tooth wheel (in a pocket in the lower plate), and its pinion turns the first intermediate wheel. Runs in plain delrin holes; one crown turn = one tooth.

hands.name: Hour disc
hands.role: Ø19 black delrin, numerals V-carved and filled. Sits right on the hour wheel. Turns the other way to the minute disc (three reductions).

hands.name: Minute disc
hands.role: Ø19 black delrin, V-carved and filled; on the minute rod at the hour disc's height.

plate.name: Bench
plate.role: Just the bench under the movement; the plates are the drawn parts.
